title: Length-machine configuration
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Boolean Turing machine, let $x$ be a Boolean input list, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on $x$. For an optional state $q$ of the enlarged machine, an index $i$ with $i\le |x|$, and a natural number $r$, define a configuration of the enlarged machine on $x$ whose state is $q$, input-head position is $i+1$, and positions on the original $k$ work tapes are those inherited from $c$; the additional work-head position is $r-1$. Its tape contents and output are obtained from $c$ by the capture construction.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Boolean Turing machine
$q$ is an optional state of the enlarged machine
caveat: The formal snippet uses captureCfg without including its definition, so the precise inherited tape contents and output cannot be fully described from the supplied statement.
